patch_description: Add a source-dominator decomposition candidate for large fan-outs. Destination groups whose routes must leave the source through different dominator branches cannot share a paid prefix, so their directed-Steiner subproblems can be solved independently and their edge unions merged. This extends exact optimization beyond the global terminal cutoff without increasing the exponential DP state space to all destinations at once. The existing clustered and greedy candidates remain available as safeguards, and the final union-cost selection retains the lowest-cost valid topology.
